deploy-bot: Deploy starting: api-gateway v2026.03.21. Backout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-api-gateway-2026-03-21 :rocket:
ana: Oncall ack. I'll own rollback for first 10m. Ping me for any canary holds.
mike: Release lead. Canary rules: abort if 5xx > 1% for 3m OR p95 latency +30% vs baseline for 2 checks.
sre-oncall: Prechecks passed. Alerting route -> #alerts + pager. I'll watch infra signals and readiness gates.
ops_lee: Runbook note: DB migration guarded by feature-flag. If rollback, follow step 4a (disable flag) before traffic switch. DO NOT flush caches until DB state confirmed. Added comment to runbook section "db-guardrails".
cs_claire: If we roll back, draft this customer line: "We reverted a routine rollout; core APIs are stable. We'll follow up if any visible impact."
devex_ravi: I'll hold the changelog PR and prepare a revert template.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 20% traffic -> dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/api-gateway/canary-2026-03-21
ana: 20% looks clean. No 5xx, latencies nominal. Proceeding to 60%.
mike: Rollback command (ops console):
```
deployctl rollback --service api-gateway --env prod --to-tag v2026.02.28 --reason "canary-failure"
```
Follow runbook order: disable feature-flag -> switch traffic -> verify probes -> then cache prune if needed.
sre-oncall: I'll enable automated canary check to post a hold message here if thresholds breach.
ops_lee: Note for whoever runs rollback: include note `--preserve-migrations=false` to ensure DB state revert is not attempted. It's in runbook step 4c.
ana: Acknowledged. Will report back at 60% or sooner on any triggers. :white_check_mark:
